paragraphs.text: The words listed here are known translations. They are confirmed either through multiple sources because they are used in stand-alone situations, or because they have been provided by Wizards of the Coast . The last vowel of a word has been omitted since it denotes a conjugation of the word instead of being part of its root.
Phyrexian has words that don't correlate one-to-one with words in English, but rather indicate the tense and mood of the following phrase:

Phyrexian has small word particles that modify a word's meaning (derivational) or are generally related to English prepositions (inflectional), indicating spatial, temporal, and semantic relations between root words. These particles are normally prefixes, but some appear as suffixes or as a combination of both.
The words listed here are believed to be accurate translations of words but do not have the level of certainty that confirmed words have.
The words listed here have been created using a structure provided by an existing, known word. There are no official sources for these words.
